Research Question: Does the fixed B1 candidate produce reviewable verified trajectories on 20 fixed training-only tasks for an initial SFT integrity probe?
Hypothesis: The cohort yields at least two distinct tasks with successful trajectories whose complete supervised turns are acceptable after explicit grounding and target-scope review.
Independent Variable: New training-pool tasks under the fixed B1 candidate; no prompt search or parameter update
Evidence Gate: At least two distinct training tasks have explicit quality-approved successful trajectories; task and prompt hashes match the fixed manifest; online/replay equality holds; no unresolved infrastructure fault. This does not authorize a formal S1/S2 study or prove B1 generalization.
Cost Bound: User waived monetary gating on 2026-09-10. Keep one GPU, one seed, at most 20 rollouts and 1800 process seconds. Record actual hourly price if known; otherwise cost=null. Preparation/idle/storage remain separate from process usage.
Failure Branch: Preserve all runs. Stop on infrastructure failure or deadline. If fewer than two acceptable successes, report data-source branch without automatically replacing tasks, adding seeds, editing prompt or enlarging model/context.
